朝鮮防疫統計 1939

Chōsen bōeki tōkei (Epidemic Prevention Statistics of Korea), 昭和十四年 (Shōwa 14), published 1941
朝鮮總督府警務局, 京城, 1941 (昭和十六年四月一日發行)

All 76 tables are transcribed; the 凡例, the contents and the map of Korea are not. Each table is printed across both pages of a spread and is given here as one table, including those that run over several spreads. The book has an unusual number of printed totals that do not add up (a check of the scan confirmed several, e.g. a monthly total of 189 where the parts give 280): they are kept as printed and noted in each table, as are a few printed numbering and heading errors. Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Province names and a few characters are given in the old forms the book uses (忠淸, 慶尙, 黃, 齡, 檢査). 17 of about 130,000 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?].
